fields.name: Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program (4Ps)
fields.summary: Conditional cash grants for poor households with children 0-18 or a pregnant member, tied to school attendance and health check-ups.
fields.summary_en: Conditional cash grants for poor households with children 0-18 or a pregnant member, tied to school attendance and health check-ups.
fields.summary_fil: Kondisyonal na cash grant para sa mahihirap na pamilyang may anak na 0-18 o buntis, kapalit ng pagpasok sa paaralan at pagpapa-check-up.
fields.benefits: Monthly health and education grants and rice subsidy (amounts set by DSWD).
fields.benefits_en: Monthly health and education grants and rice subsidy (amounts set by DSWD).
fields.how_to_apply: Households are selected from the DSWD Listahanan. Ask your MSWDO or the 4Ps Municipal Link if your household was assessed.
fields.how_to_apply_en: Households are selected from the DSWD Listahanan. Ask your MSWDO or the 4Ps Municipal Link if your household was assessed.
fields.eligibility_notes: Household must be assessed as poor by Listahanan and have children 0-18 or a pregnant member.
fields.eligibility_notes_en: Household must be assessed as poor by Listahanan and have children 0-18 or a pregnant member.

fields.name: TUPAD emergency employment
fields.name_fil: TUPAD (Tulong Panghanapbuhay sa Ating Disadvantaged/Displaced Workers)

fields.summary_en: Short-term community work (10-30 days) for displaced, underemployed and informal workers, paid at the regional minimum wage.
fields.summary_fil: Panandaliang trabaho (10-30 araw) para sa nawalan ng hanapbuhay at impormal na manggagawa, bayad sa minimum wage ng rehiyon.
fields.how_to_apply: Register through your barangay or the PESO/Mayor's Office when a TUPAD batch is announced.
fields.how_to_apply_en: Register through your barangay or the PESO/Mayor's Office when a TUPAD batch is announced.
fields.eligibility_notes: At least 18 years old; one beneficiary per family per year.
fields.eligibility_notes_en: At least 18 years old; one beneficiary per family per year.

fields.summary_en: Medical, burial, transportation, educational and food assistance for individuals and families in crisis.
fields.summary_fil: Tulong medikal, pampalibing, pamasahe, pang-edukasyon at pagkain para sa nasa krisis.

fields.title: Before and during a typhoon
fields.title_en: Before and during a typhoon
fields.body:
Monitor PAGASA bulletins and LGU alerts.
Prepare a go-bag: water, food for 3 days, medicines, flashlight, radio, power bank, copies of IDs.
Secure your roof and bring in loose objects.
Know your barangay's evacuation center and route.
Evacuate early when told by the MDRRMO or barangay officials.
fields.body_en:
Monitor PAGASA bulletins and LGU alerts.
Prepare a go-bag: water, food for 3 days, medicines, flashlight, radio, power bank, copies of IDs.
Secure your roof and bring in loose objects.
Know your barangay's evacuation center and route.
Evacuate early when told by the MDRRMO or barangay officials.
fields.body_fil:
Subaybayan ang PAGASA at mga abiso ng LGU.
Maghanda ng go-bag: tubig, pagkain para sa 3 araw, gamot, flashlight, radyo, power bank, kopya ng ID.
Itali ang bubong at ipasok ang mga bagay na maaaring liparin.
Alamin ang evacuation center ng barangay.
Lumikas nang maaga kapag sinabihan ng MDRRMO o barangay.

Watch for cracks, tilting trees and muddy water on slopes - report them.
Move to higher ground at once if you hear rumbling.

fields.question: How do I get a cedula?
fields.question_en: How do I get a cedula?
fields.answer: Go to the Municipal Treasurer's Office with a valid ID. The basic tax is PHP 5, plus PHP 1 for every PHP 1,000 of income. It takes about 5 minutes.
fields.answer_en: Go to the Municipal Treasurer's Office with a valid ID. The basic tax is PHP 5, plus PHP 1 for every PHP 1,000 of income. It takes about 5 minutes.
fields.answer_fil: Pumunta sa Municipal Treasurer's Office dala ang valid ID. PHP 5 ang basic, dagdag PHP 1 bawat PHP 1,000 na kita. Mga 5 minuto lang.
fields.answer_rol: Mag-adto sa Municipal Treasurer's Office dara ang imong ID. PHP 5 ang basic, dugang PHP 1 kada PHP 1,000 nga kita. Mga 5 minutos lang. (Draft translation)

fields.question: How do I get a copy of my birth certificate?
fields.question_en: How do I get a copy of my birth certificate?
fields.question_fil: Paano kumuha ng kopya ng birth certificate?
fields.question_rol: Pauno mag-kuha it kopya it birth certificate?
fields.answer: Ask the Municipal Civil Registrar in the town where the birth was registered. Bring a valid ID. For a PSA copy, request it through the MCR or a PSA outlet.
fields.answer_en: Ask the Municipal Civil Registrar in the town where the birth was registered. Bring a valid ID. For a PSA copy, request it through the MCR or a PSA outlet.
fields.answer_fil: Magtanong sa Municipal Civil Registrar ng bayan kung saan nakarehistro ang kapanganakan. Magdala ng ID. Para sa kopya ng PSA, mag-request sa MCR o sa PSA.
fields.answer_rol: Pamangkot sa Municipal Civil Registrar it banwa kung diin narehistro. Mag-dara it ID. (Draft translation)
fields.keywords: birth certificate, psa, nso, civil registry
fields.keywords_en: birth certificate, psa, nso, civil registry

fields.question: Is the ferry cancelled today?
fields.question_fil: May biyahe ba ang barko ngayon?
fields.question_rol: May biyahe bala ang barko subong?
fields.answer: Check the Ferry Board, which port and LGU staff update. Sailings are suspended when PAGASA raises a gale warning or wind signal. Always confirm with the shipping line.
fields.answer_en: Check the Ferry Board, which port and LGU staff update. Sailings are suspended when PAGASA raises a gale warning or wind signal. Always confirm with the shipping line.
fields.answer_fil: Tingnan ang Ferry Board na ina-update ng port at LGU. Walang biyahe kapag may gale warning o signal ng bagyo. Kumpirmahin sa shipping line.
fields.answer_rol: Tan-awa ang Ferry Board. Wara it biyahe kung may gale warning o signal it bagyo. (Draft translation)
fields.keywords: ferry, boat, ship, schedule, cancelled, sailing
fields.keywords_en: ferry, boat, ship, schedule, cancelled, sailing

fields.question: What is the emergency hotline?
fields.answer: Dial 911 for any emergency. Town MDRRMO, police, fire and health numbers are on the Emergency page, which also works offline.
fields.answer_en: Dial 911 for any emergency. Town MDRRMO, police, fire and health numbers are on the Emergency page, which also works offline.
fields.answer_fil: Tumawag sa 911 para sa anumang emergency. Nasa Emergency page ang numero ng MDRRMO, pulis, bumbero at RHU ng bawat bayan, at gumagana ito kahit offline.
fields.answer_rol: Tawag sa 911 kung may emergency. Ang mga numero it MDRRMO, pulis kag bumbero yara sa Emergency page. (Draft translation)
fields.keywords: emergency, hotline, police, fire, ambulance, mdrrmo, 911
fields.keywords_en: emergency, hotline, police, fire, ambulance, mdrrmo, 911

fields.question: How do I get a senior citizen ID?
fields.question_en: How do I get a senior citizen ID?
fields.question_fil: Paano kumuha ng senior citizen ID?
fields.question_rol: Pauno mag-kuha it senior citizen ID?
fields.answer: Go to the Office of Senior Citizens Affairs (OSCA) with proof of age, two 1x1 photos and a barangay certificate of residency. It is free.
fields.answer_en: Go to the Office of Senior Citizens Affairs (OSCA) with proof of age, two 1x1 photos and a barangay certificate of residency. It is free.
fields.answer_fil: Pumunta sa OSCA dala ang patunay ng edad, dalawang 1x1 na litrato at barangay certificate of residency. Libre ito.
fields.answer_rol: Mag-adto sa OSCA dara ang patunay it edad, duha ka 1x1 nga litrato kag barangay certificate. Libre ra. (Draft translation)

fields.question: When must I renew my business permit?
fields.question_en: When must I renew my business permit?
fields.question_fil: Kailan dapat i-renew ang business permit?
fields.answer: Every January. Pay business taxes within the first 20 days of January to avoid surcharges. Bring your previous permit and sworn declaration of gross sales to the BPLO.
fields.answer_en: Every January. Pay business taxes within the first 20 days of January to avoid surcharges. Bring your previous permit and sworn declaration of gross sales to the BPLO.
fields.answer_fil: Tuwing Enero. Bayaran ang buwis sa unang 20 araw ng Enero para walang multa. Dalhin ang lumang permit at sworn declaration of gross sales sa BPLO.
fields.keywords: business permit, renewal, mayor's permit, bplo
fields.keywords_en: business permit, renewal, mayor's permit, bplo

fields.question: Can I climb Mt. Guiting-Guiting?
fields.question_fil: Puwede bang umakyat sa Mt. Guiting-Guiting?
fields.answer: Only with a permit from the Protected Area Office (DENR) and an accredited guide, and only when the trail is open. It is usually closed during the rainy season. Register with the Magdiwang Tourism Office first.
fields.answer_en: Only with a permit from the Protected Area Office (DENR) and an accredited guide, and only when the trail is open. It is usually closed during the rainy season. Register with the Magdiwang Tourism Office first.
fields.answer_fil: Kailangan ng permit mula sa Protected Area Office (DENR) at accredited guide, at kapag bukas lang ang trail. Karaniwang sarado tuwing tag-ulan.
fields.answer_rol: Kinahangean it permit halin sa DENR kag accredited guide. Sarado kung tag-uean. (Draft translation)
fields.keywords: climb, mountain, guiting, trail, permit, denr, hike
fields.keywords_en: climb, mountain, guiting, trail, permit, denr, hike

fields.question: How do I follow up my concern?
fields.question_en: How do I follow up my concern?
fields.question_fil: Paano i-follow up ang aking concern?
fields.question_rol: Pauno ko i-follow up ang akon concern?
fields.answer: Open the link we emailed you, or go to Track a concern and enter your ticket number and the email or mobile number you used. You can message the office there.
fields.answer_en: Open the link we emailed you, or go to Track a concern and enter your ticket number and the email or mobile number you used. You can message the office there.
fields.answer_fil: Buksan ang link na in-email sa iyo, o pumunta sa Track a concern at ilagay ang ticket number at email o mobile number na ginamit mo.
fields.answer_rol: Bukasa ang link nga gin-email sa imo, o mag-adto sa Track a concern. (Draft translation)
fields.keywords: ticket, follow up, status, track, concern, complaint
fields.keywords_en: ticket, follow up, status, track, concern, complaint

fields.question: How can my family join 4Ps?
fields.answer: 4Ps households are chosen from the DSWD Listahanan assessment of poor households. Ask your MSWDO or the 4Ps Municipal Link whether your household has been assessed.
fields.answer_en: 4Ps households are chosen from the DSWD Listahanan assessment of poor households. Ask your MSWDO or the 4Ps Municipal Link whether your household has been assessed.
fields.answer_fil: Pinipili ang mga pamilya sa 4Ps mula sa Listahanan ng DSWD. Magtanong sa MSWDO o sa 4Ps Municipal Link.
fields.answer_rol: Ang mga pamilya sa 4Ps ginapili halin sa Listahanan it DSWD. Pamangkot sa MSWDO. (Draft translation)
